source: 1968 Chevrolet Chassis Service Manual, Corvette Body, p.1B-20

procedures.title: Folding top compartment lid lock: remove and install
steps: Remove the 3 lock retaining screws and take the lock off the lid.
Installation: Set the lock on the lid lined up with the scribe mark and install its screws.
Fit the cable end into the control and secure the retainer.
Test the lock thoroughly and adjust if needed (see lock adjustment).

procedures.title: Folding top compartment lid lock control: remove and install
steps: Removal: Remove the inner mounting clamps from both cables and unhook the cables from the control by removing the retainers.
Remove the 4 mounting screws and take the control off the lid.
Installation: Set the control on the lid and install the mounting screws.
Fit both cable ends into the control and secure them with the retainers.
Engage the push rod with its retainer.
Test the locks and adjust if necessary.

procedures.title: Gas tank door and rear trim: replace and adjust
steps: Replace the gas tank door assembly and bezel by removing the sheet metal screws around the inner face of the bezel.
To adjust latch holding force, remove the door assembly and turn the individual lock pins with an Allen wrench.
Trim letters are held by special nuts reached from under the car.
notes: Installation details shown in figure 47 in the manual.

procedures.title: Rear filler panel: remove and install
steps: Remove the rear license plate and its housing (see Section 14).
Disconnect the tail pipes from the mufflers.
Remove the 8 screws holding the filler panel to the body (see figure 47 in the manual).
Install by reversing these steps.

procedures.title: Spare tire mount: remove and install
steps: Removal: Take out the spare tire as described in the Owner's Manual.
Loosen the pivot bolt lock nuts and back the pivot bolts out of the crossmember weld nuts.
Remove the 2 screws holding the swivel bolt assembly to the body.
Remove the 4 bolts holding the cover assembly to the body.
Installation: reverse the removal steps; grease the nut and bolt threads with chassis grease before fitting the swivel bolt assembly.

procedures.title: Rear grille and plenum air door: remove and install
steps: Remove the 4 screws holding the grille to the rear deck panel.
Remove the 3 screws holding the frame, plenum air door and gasket assembly.
Use new fasteners when replacing the rubber door.
Install by reversing these steps.
